alternative_fix_sites: relay/limiter.py::Bucket._ms_for (any exact ceiling, e.g. (missing + tokens - 1) // tokens or math.ceil)
relay/limiter.py::Bucket.take and Bucket.wait (rounding up at both call sites instead of in the helper)
notes: The helper that converts missing bucket units into a wait floors the division instead of rounding up, so whenever the rate's token count does not divide the missing units (3/s, 6/s, 7/2s, 9/2s) a debt wait is 1 ms short: the job becomes ready one millisecond before its token is fully earned, and a max-wait check can accept a take that needs 1 ms more than allowed. Rates that divide evenly (2/s, 4/s, 5/s, 1/250ms, 10/s) are unaffected, which is all the public tests use. Probes cover Bucket.take/wait, Limiter.reserve/wait/available and a max-wait boundary, dispatcher ready and start times for two rates, and the script language, so fixing only take (not wait) or special-casing 3/s fails.
